html_url.description: SANDBOX_HTML_URL from an execute_code result, or "/_upload/documents/<path>.html"

wait_ms.description: Settle time in ms after page load before actions/screenshot (default 2000) — increase for slow-building pages or animations

actions.description: Optional interaction sequence, run in order, each item ONE of: {"click": "<css-selector>"} | {"fill": {"selector": "<css>", "text": "..."}} | {"press": "<key e.g. Enter>"} | {"mouse_drag": {"from": [x, y], "to": [x, y]}} (viewport pixels, viewport 1280x800) | {"wait_ms": <int>} | {"screenshot": true} (intermediate shot). A final screenshot is always taken.

vision_focus.description: Specific verification question for the automatic screenshot description, e.g. 'Is the wireframe terrain visible and does the laser beam end at the ground?' — answered first, then the rest is described. All screenshots of this call are described together as one chronological sequence, so before/after questions across shots work. Pass it whenever you render to verify a specific change.
